tenderSchedule.title: CAR AMBULANCE AND 02 NO. OF JEEPS/EQUIVALENT FOR VHEP
tenderSchedule.description: Providing One no. of A3 Segment sedan class A/C (3plus1) seater CAR (12 Hrs. duty), One no. of Type B AMBULANCE with basic life support facility (24 Hrs. duty) and Two nos. of (6plus1) seater Jeep(24 Hrs. duty) all of model 2023 onwards with GPS fitted along with drivers on monthly hire basis for a period of Two years ( extendable one more year based on performance of the agency & condition of the vehicles)
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer MSP Office SVP VARAHI

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
None of the contracts of the bidder should have been terminated/foreclosed on account of his default in KPCL or elsewhere during last three years
All other terms & conditions as per in the tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall have proven experience in providing vehicles to any utility pertaining to various PSUs, State Govt. / Central Govt./ any reputed organisations who have successfully completed at least one work of providing two vehicles with minimum 1 year contract during the preceding five years (i.e., 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 and the period up to the date of submission of bid. The bidder should upload scanned copy of work order & work done certificate issued by competent authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- work order and work done certificate issued by competent authority

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.70.75Lakhs in any two years during the preceding five financial years i.e., 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of turnover, the bidder shall upload scanned copies of turnover certificate/ profit & loss account statements duly certified by the chartered accountant. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present level of the financial year.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
